build_segmentation_loss: build a SegmentationLoss instance from a Detectron2 CfgNode config to compute cross-entropy segmentation loss
compute_segmentation_loss: compute cross-entropy segmentation loss by calling SegmentationLoss with proposals, predictor outputs, and packed annotations
resample_coarse_segm_gt: resample coarse segmentation ground truth to heatmap size using nearest neighbor interpolation and bounding box alignment
create_fake_segmentation_loss: create a zero-valued fake segmentation loss tensor to maintain computation graph consistency across GPUs in DDP
review_SegmentationLoss_call: review the SegmentationLoss __call__ method to understand how coarse segmentation estimates are compared against resampled ground truth labels
